allow: Bash(PGPASSWORD=mypassword "C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\psql.exe" -U postgres -h localhost -d snap -c "EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT *, ST_Distance(location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(79.8612, 6.9271), 4326)::geography) as distance_meters FROM shops WHERE ST_DWithin(location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(79.8612, 6.9271), 4326)::geography, 10000) ORDER BY distance_meters LIMIT 5;")
